info.title: Coderax WorkflowEngine API
info.description: Authoritative HTTP surface for Coderax Native intelligence, agent orchestration and durable Work execution. Every operation is generated from the versioned route catalogue.

get.summary: Discover the three agent identities and their truthful availability.

post.summary: One Chat turn. Streams SSE frames when the client accepts them.

get.summary: Conversation history shared by web and CLI clients.
One conversation with its persisted messages.
Liveness and dependency health for the engine.
Owner-scoped memory for the requested data mode.
Discover models, cost class and the zero-cost route.
Durable completion notifications, including unread count.

post.summary: Mark every completion notification and schedule notice for this owner as read.

get.summary: Whether the engine finished startup validation.

post.summary: Fire a named event; each matching event-triggered schedule runs at most once.

get.summary: List this owner's schedules with their next run and state.

post.summary: Create a durable, owner-controlled schedule executed by the engine.

get.summary: One schedule with its authoritative state and next run.

patch.summary: Edit timing, condition, retry or limits; the execution identity cannot be widened.

post.summary: Cancel a schedule permanently and cancel its current Work task.

get.summary: Durable execution receipts for one schedule, newest first.

post.summary: Pause future occurrences; a run already in flight is not stopped.
Resume a paused schedule from the next occurrence; missed runs are not stormed.
Run one occurrence now, deduplicated by the supplied idempotency key.

get.summary: Preview the next occurrences without creating a receipt or a task.

post.summary: Submit a durable Work task; returns before execution finishes.

get.summary: Authoritative task status, including terminal state and failure.

post.summary: Request cancellation. Safe from any replica and after disconnect.

get.summary: Replay and tail execution events from a sequence cursor.
Pending and decided permission requests for a task.

post.summary: Approve or deny one scoped permission request.
Resume a suspended or interrupted task from its last checkpoint.
Retry a failed task on the same engine with a new generation.
